title: Creating an identity: the eagle and the serpent
goal: Read how new countries used the past to build an identity, and use the subjunctive after value judgments to say what is important or necessary.

items: Use the subjunctive after value judgments (*es importante que*, *es necesario que*) to say what historians think matters.
Say where the Mexican eagle and serpent come from.
Say what contradiction historians see in the use of the indigenous past.
Say why the elites liked to speak of a glorious past.
Use the key words of this lesson: eagle, glorious, pride, elite, marginalization and contradiction.
